title: S3 multipart artifact upload ignores configured SSE-S3/SSE-KMS arguments
answers: large artifact upload to S3 rejected when bucket requires server-side encryption
MLFLOW_S3_UPLOAD_EXTRA_ARGS encryption not applied to multipart artifact uploads
create multipart upload denied by S3 bucket policy requiring SSE-KMS
body:
Symptom: Artifacts above the multipart threshold fail to upload to S3 buckets whose policy requires SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS, even though encryption is set in the repository constructor or via MLFLOW_S3_UPLOAD_EXTRA_ARGS.
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/optimized_s3_artifact_repo.py:OptimizedS3ArtifactRepository._multipart_upload called create_multipart_upload with only self._bucket_owner_params, so the encryption args that _upload_file passes to upload_file were never sent.
Fix pattern: Merge the encryption subset from _get_multipart_upload_encryption_args into the create_multipart_upload call, with environment args (get_s3_file_upload_extra_args) layered over repository args.
Constraints: Only ServerSideEncryption, SSEKMSKeyId, SSEKMSEncryptionContext and BucketKeyEnabled are forwarded. Generic transfer options such as ACL are dropped because they are not universally valid on CreateMultipartUpload. SSE-C fields are dropped because they must also be sent on upload_part and complete calls, which this path does not do.
applies: Explicit multipart upload path of OptimizedS3ArtifactRepository only; regular single-request uploads go through _upload_file.
says: Large model artifacts fail to upload to encrypted cloud storage buckets requiring server-side encryption.
Uploads for big files are rejected by bucket policies enforcing custom encryption keys.
Pass configured storage encryption parameters to chunked file uploads so secured buckets accept them.
Multi-part artifact uploads fail on protected storage even though bucket encryption settings are configured.
Small run artifacts upload successfully but larger files fail bucket encryption policy checks.
search: Multipart S3 artifact uploads in OptimizedS3ArtifactRepository._multipart_upload must forward configured SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS encryption arguments to create_multipart_upload. The fix merges encryption arguments from _get_multipart_upload_encryption_args layered with MLFLOW_S3_UPLOAD_EXTRA_ARGS over repository arguments, applying strictly to the explicit multipart upload path. Only ServerSideEncryption, SSEKMSKeyId, SSEKMSEncryptionContext, and BucketKeyEnabled are forwarded; generic transfer options like ACL and customer-provided SSE-C fields are dropped.
